content:
Take a deep breath in, and let’s find a little more ease and alignment in this Warrior I pose together. You're doing great, but let’s make a few small adjustments to help you get the most out of your posture and keep you safe.

First, let's look at your spine. Notice how you’re leaning slightly forward? Try to lengthen your tailbone down toward the mat and lift through the crown of your head. Imagine your spine growing taller and longer, keeping your torso perpendicular to the floor. This will help you feel much more grounded and stable.

Next, bring your awareness to your arms. Notice that they’ve softened a bit—let's reach them actively up toward the ceiling. Keep your elbows engaged and fingers spread wide as if you’re pulling energy up through your fingertips. Even if your palms don't touch, keep that upward intention strong; it really helps open up the chest and shoulders.

Finally, let’s check your front leg. You're currently a little out of alignment, so let’s adjust that front knee. Shift your weight back slightly until your knee is stacked directly over your ankle. This small shift does wonders for protecting your knee joint and gives you a much firmer foundation to stand in your power.

There you go—that looks much stronger. Feel how grounding it is when you’re fully aligned? Keep breathing deeply, you're doing excellent work.
